To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
cognitive radio networks are extremely susceptible to smart jammers that attack the spectrum sensing and channel-switching procedures of the network.

the anti-jam performance of the CRN is significantly influenced by the number of jammers and the jamming power, and the CRN is more susceptible to the jamming attacks targeting its spectrum sensing and channel selection procedures.
the anti-jam capability of a CRN is determined by the number of jammers and the number of available channels, and that the anti-jaming performance of the CRN is improved by using more channels.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the jamming and anti-jamming issues of cognitive radio networks in fading environments
the jamming and anti-jamming capabilities of CRN under multiple uncooperative jamming attacks in a fading environment

the jamming capability and anti-jamming ability of the CRN under the multiple uncoordinated jamming environment, which is of great significance to the design of the anti-jammer strategy and jamming attack strategy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the jamming capability is significantly improved with the increase in the number of jammers.
the CRN anti-jamming capacity is limited by the number of available orthogonal channels, the channel sensing time, and the channel switching time.
the anti-jam capability of CRN can be significantly improved by using a smart jamming strategy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the jammer's smartness can greatly enhance its jamming capability.
the jamming capability is a function of the number of uncoordinated jammings, while the anti-jam capability is a function both of the number of jammings and the channel fading environment.

the jamming capability is enhanced by increasing the jamming power and the number of jammers, while the jamming performance is improved by increasing the number of sensing channels, the sensing time and the sensing power.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CRN communications are extremely susceptible to smart-jamming-attack strategies, and the jamming capability is significantly enhanced by the jammer cooperation.
the anti-jammer design of CRN should be carefully done to mitigate the smart jamming attacks.
, in order to improve the anti-jam capability of CRN, the CRN should be designed in a way that it can be less susceptible to the jamming attacks.
